description: A grand residential front entry photographed at standing eye-level with a centered composition, framing a dramatic arched doorway in a whitewashed brick facade. The brick is a vintage-style light cream and ivory painted or limewashed brick with exposed mortar joints, and the arch is a beautiful full semicircular voussoir arch constructed from warm terracotta-red exposed brick that contrasts richly with the whitewashed field. The entry door itself is matte black with vertical fluted panel detail — a bold, modern-classical front door that anchors the archway. Two wall-mounted lantern-style fixtures flank the arch, each mounted symmetrically on either side of the doorframe. A warm amber glow spills from within each lantern, washing the pale brick wall surface around each mounting point and casting soft upward and downward light across the facade texture. The light from the fixtures creates a visible warm pool on the brick to the left and right of the arch. To the right of the arch, the facade transitions into a projecting bay with large-pane black steel-framed windows — both single-hung and steel casement types — creating a very high-contrast black and white material composition. Tree branches and foliage in soft focus are visible through the window glazing. The facade cladding in the upper right transitions to dark painted horizontal boards, adding a board-and-batten or Hardie-panel element at the upper story. The mood is stately, formal, and architecturally striking — an elegant neo-traditional facade with classical arch and modern material contrasts. Camera is at standing height, looking level, with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition focused squarely on the arch and door.
